runs.text: The Yadav were traditionally herders and milk sellers, maybe from Central Asia. They identify closely with their caste deity, Krishna. However, most Yadavs today grow crops, while less than one third work with cows. They live almost all over India and in southern Nepal. The highest concentration is in the states Uttar Pradesh and Bihar (north India). The Yadav live in joint families. Most are vegetarian but many have started eating fish, mutton, chicken and sometimes pork, but not beef.
The Yadav are seen as socially and educationally backward. They are one of the most numerous Other Backward Castes (OBC) people.

about their gods: Krishna, Vishnu and others. They claim Krishna as their blood ancestor and so are especially devoted to him. For protection from curses, the Yadav put faith in amulets, astrologers and traditional healers.
Their lives and living standards are changing all over the nation. The next generation will need to get other kinds of jobs, but proper education is missing in many places.
The Yadavs of India are the 5th largest unreached people group in the world and the third largest in India. Only 0.002% of them are reported to be Jesus followers.

They need to hear about the way of salvation. Most of the Yadav die never hearing the name of Jesus even once. In recent years there are some families and whole villages of Yadavs moving towards Christ, some led by Yadav followers of Jesus.
The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned.
Pray that God will bless the Yadav so the people walking in darkness can see His great light.
Pray that the Lord will draw the Yadav to those who can share His Words and love with them and invite them into discipleship communities.

in ways that can spread easily through the whole community.
Pray for young Yadavs who cannot make a living in their traditional ways. Pray that their searching would lead them to better jobs and to Jesus.
Pray for the families and villages that are moving towards Jesus – for courage, hope, perseverance, and joy.
